title: Upgrade and No Grow
body:
1. Paid for premium and still see option to upgrade. 

2. Says infinite days until new growth. Does this mean my tree is dead? How does the system work? Please clarify
author: Jimm-bopp

title: Intrinsic motivation that needs more "productivity"
body:
It's my second day using it and I'm really enjoying the concept of nourishing a plant - a positive habit - with consistent action.
The motivation resonates with me but I'd also like a bit more "productivity" functionality, like being able to tick off the daily completion of habit activity and to record what I'd done before I started using the app.

I like it.
author: iOS 11 must fall
